name: Shirokuro Camera
description: Shirokuro Camera — a WooCommerce store theme for a small film camera shop on a hillside street, laid out as an asymmetric masonry. A formal centred top header carries the Shop cameras button on the left, the shop name in the middle, account and cart on the right and the main menu centred on its own row below, under a strip of clay sprocket holes; below 1100 px a Menu button opens it as a full-screen mikan overlay. Mikan orange (#F08300) is the main colour: the hero field, the counter board lead tile, the camera shelf band, the darkroom card, every page head and the footer strip are mikan fields with camera-black text, and raster clay textures (film sprocket holes and a halftone of clay dots) run through them. The hero shows the clay shop interior through a black viewfinder window with rounded corners and frame marks; a cream card with the lead overlaps the window and a cut-out clay camera (transparent WebP) breaks out over the window frame and the hero's bottom edge. The counter board, the five checks, the camera shelf, the darkroom collage and the counter notes are all uneven masonry tiles and columns, and a cut-out film roll breaks out of the darkroom card. Every picture is a soft 3D clay illustration. DotGothic16 for display, Lexend Deca for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical lines only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-15 (asymmetric-masonry, framed-window hero, centered nav, pattern-texture, 3d-clay, mikan #F08300, DotGothic16 + Lexend Deca, film camera shop in shops-hobbies). A formal centred top header under a strip of clay sprocket holes: the Shop cameras button on the left, the shop name in the middle, account and cart on the right; from 1100 px the main menu stands centred on its own row below (numbered entries), below 1100 px a Menu button opens it as a full-screen mikan overlay. Framed window: the hero shows the clay shop interior through a black viewfinder window with rounded corners and frame marks on the mikan field. Asymmetric masonry: the counter board is a masonry of uneven tiles (a tall mikan lead tile), the five checks and the tall repair picture flow in masonry columns, the camera shelf and the shop grid are masonry columns of tall, square and wide cards, the darkroom band is a three-tile collage and the counter notes are masonry cards. Pattern texture: raster clay textures (film sprocket holes and a halftone of clay dots) on the header strip, the hero, the board lead tile, the shelf band, page heads and the footer strip. 3D clay: every picture is a soft 3D clay illustration (Grok Build). Break-frame: the cut-out clay camera (transparent WebP) breaks out over the top-right frame of the hero viewfinder window and above the window; the cream lead card overlaps the window and the hero bottom edge; the cut-out film roll breaks out of the top edge of the mikan darkroom card; the camera also breaks over the bottom edge of every page head. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: camera black #1E1A16 on mikan #F08300 6.5:1 (all text on the hero field, the board lead tile, the shelf band, the darkroom card, the second check tile, the second promise tile, every page head, the mikan overlay menu and the footer strip; the clay textures are masked away from the text or lightened); ink on warm paper #FFF7EC 16.3:1, on white 17.3:1 and on pale mikan #FDE8CF 14.5:1; deep mikan #8F3D00 on paper 7.0:1, on white 7.4:1 and on pale mikan 6.2:1 (links, prices, labels, menu numbers; white on deep 7.4:1); warm grey #5F5247 on paper 7.1:1, on white 7.5:1 and on pale mikan 6.3:1 (secondary text); white on camera-black buttons 17.3:1; mikan on ink 6.5:1 and pale mikan #FFD9A8 on ink 13.0:1 (the black tile, chips, footer); lens teal #1D6B66 on paper 5.9:1 (small square marks only); white on mikan only 2.6:1, never used for text.

summary.zh-TW: 蜜柑橘的底片相機店：置中選單、不對稱瀑布流版面，從觀景窗看見黏土風的店內，去背相機破框而出；含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A mikan-orange film camera store in asymmetric masonry: centred menu, clay shop through a viewfinder window, cut-out camera breaking out.
summary.ja: 蜜柑色のフィルムカメラ店。中央そろえのメニューと非対称のメイソンリー、ファインダー窓の粘土の店内から切り抜きのカメラが飛び出します。
summary.fr: Une boutique d’appareils argentiques orange mikan en maçonnerie asymétrique : menu centré, boutique en pâte à modeler vue par un viseur.
summary.de: Ein mikan-oranger Filmkameraladen im asymmetrischen Mauerwerk: zentriertes Menü, Knetladen im Sucherfenster, freigestellte Kamera.
